k2_tail.target: SENSITIVITY RANGE — not a pass/fail check
k2_tail.note: TAIL CAVEAT (mandatory): ⟨k²⟩ is the most under-captured quantity in all available empirical datasets (RDS is itself a network walk; high-degree tail is systematically missed). ⟨k²⟩ directly sets τ_c. Treat as sensitivity axis. See Stage 3 sweep for τ_c band.
